card.name: Space before a reported incidence number
card.fires_on: The space right before a number in a sentence reporting how many or what percent of patients had an event, e.g. 'the incidence of X was' followed by a figure. It also fires between counts in lists of patient numbers.

modes.label: Incidence was [number]
modes.description: Space after 'was' or 'in' just before a percentage or count of patients with an adverse event.
modes.example: the incidence of Grade ≥3 ILD was<< >>1.3% and resulted in death

modes.label: Counts in a list
modes.description: Space between listed patient counts in trial result sentences.
modes.example: recurrence of ALT ≥3 times ULN was observed in no patient receiving avelumab,<< >>6 patients receiving INLYTA, and

card.writes: It favors words meaning looking back, plus percent-rate characters, so it mainly pushes numeric result continuations.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before a trial result figure, such as the percent of patients who had a side effect.
